items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Do not approve new spend, monetization forecasts, ROI claims, or additional production work. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all in an aggregate tracking row that cannot be assigned to a site; named site rows show $0 attributed commission. Therefore site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, and causal lift are unsupported. September AI usage cost is $1,002.46 across 5,531 calls and 39 instrumented sites, but comparing it with the one-day $4.92 revenue would be period-invalid. The 17 SEO conversions and click/impression totals are vanity metrics until mapped to attributable revenue. Preserve the existing capacity gate and execute no new financial or production work until attribution and variable-cost evidence are reconciled.

Retain the current affiliate attribution control: every new link must use its registered tracking ID, and aggregate provider rows must remain explicitly unassigned. Do not report site revenue, ROI, or margin from the current Amazon snapshot. Reconcile the existing site-level rows and identify any missing site/date mappings using existing telemetry only.
